title: Second War of Kappel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second War of Kappel", at revision 1375450979, opens: "The Second War of Kappel was an armed conflict in 1531 between the Catholic and the Protestant cantons of the Old Swiss Confederacy during the Reformation in Switzerland." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q233594, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
